request.text: Compose original music for Crimson Thread Pilgrimage, a dark fairytale underground action-adventure. Natural acoustic instruments, expressive phrasing, clear voicing, transparent mix with space for gameplay sound effects. No imitation of existing music or named artists, no chiptune, EDM drops, trailer braams or mastering distortion. Shared original Silent Toll motif: D4 down to A3 then up to B-flat3, then a rest; leave it unresolved except in endings A and C. Crimson Thread countertheme: D4 leap to B-flat4, then A4 G4 F4 E4, in plucked timbres. 138 BPM G minor, then a semitone lift to A-flat minor. A tiny pitched scissor-like orchestral click introduces an urgent anvil and string allegro. Two-beat cutting against three-beat sewing hemiola. The cello motif is interrupted at A; in the second half spinning string figures and the complete plucked Crimson Thread countertheme challenge the scissors. Strictly instrumental; NO vocals, humming, choir, lyrics, speech or narration. Finish with texture and harmony compatible with the opening, no big final cadence, leaving a three-second editable overlap for a smooth game loop.
